actual_scalar_definitions.e2_mean_min_dist_A: Equal-pose mean of each pose mean nearest E2-ensemble-point/kinase-Lys-NZ distance over producer frames; not conditioned on bridging
actual_scalar_definitions.e2_delta_reach_50A: Mean per-pose bridge-minus-nonbridge geometric ensemble-reach fraction; only poses with both finite conditional values contribute
actual_scalar_definitions.e2_delta_reach_80A: As for 50 Å, using 80 Å; inherited bridging mask refers to legacy Elongin-B-labelled proximity
actual_scalar_definitions.lk_lys_nearest_e2_dist_A: First nonmissing static-lysine value after sorting rank within POI; not nearest across all MD frames and no mean fallback

limitations: Matching current table arithmetic does not establish immutable provenance for the historical training invocation.
Old bridging-conditioned descriptors use the historical scaffold-proximity mask.
Modeled E2 ensemble proximity to any kinase lysine is a geometric descriptor, not a catalytic or degradation probability.
Source producer truncates to minimum frame counts without timestamp verification; audit that separately before reusing the algorithm.
